name: Malaysia
description: Malaysia from the Malacca Sultanate to Portuguese, Dutch and British rule, rubber and tin, independence, the federation and the Petronas Towers.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Malaya
checkpoints.note: People lived in the Niah caves forty thousand years ago. Indian-influenced kingdoms traded along the straits.

checkpoints.name: Sultans and colonies
checkpoints.note: The Malacca Sultanate spread Islam until the Portuguese took it in 1511. The Dutch and then the British followed, and tin and rubber drew Chinese and Indian workers.

checkpoints.name: Malaysia
checkpoints.note: Malaya became independent in 1957 and Malaysia was formed in 1963. Mahathir drove industry, and Kuala Lumpur gained the tallest towers in the world.
